disease_state: inferred: The paper describes the isolation and analysis of pre-60S ribosomal particles and Drg1 protein from yeast strains, which are biological models for studying fundamental cellular mechanisms rather than disease states.
material_type: Pre-60S particles were isolated from a LmB-sensitive S. cerevisiae mutant strain (crm1T539C) using Bud20-TAP as bait.
sample_source: Cells were grown to late log-phase (OD600 1–1.2) and then treated with 135 ng/µl µM LmB for 30 minutes.
species: Here, we report a series of cryo-EM structures that captured the extraction of Rlp24 from pre-60S particles by Saccharomyces cerevisiae Drg1.
strain: Pre-60S particles were isolated from a LmB-sensitive S. cerevisiae mutant strain (crm1T539C) using Bud20-TAP as bait.
